title: Pure Junk Synchron
summary: The Junk and Synchron engine both pages cover, with the generic Level 2 extenders, the Junk Warrior Assault Mode package and generic staples; the Synchron page opens this same list. Junk Meister and Junk Armor summon themselves and search or pull the next Junk, Synchro Fellowship adds Junk Synchron plus a Junk Warrior card, and Junk Speeder calls a Synchron of every Level from the Deck. Starjunk Synchron, the newest Tuner, summons itself with a Level 2 from the GY and stands in for any Synchron. Nearly every starter locks you into Synchros for the turn, so the Extra Deck is all Synchro apart from Junk Connector.

allow.Stardust Dragon: Junk Signal, Junk Meister, Junk Mail and Synchro Fellowship all name or count Stardust; it's the classic Junk Synchron finisher.

main: Junk Meister
2026 support. Reveals a Warrior or Stardust Synchro to summon itself; summoned, searches a Junk card and lowers a Junk's Level.
Junk Armor
2026 support. Summons itself when searched; Tributes itself to pull a Junk or Synchron from the Deck; shields your Warrior Synchros.
Starjunk Synchron
Newest support. Summons itself with a Level 2 or lower from the GY, and counts as any Synchron Tuner.
Junk Synchron
Normal Summoned: revives a Level 2 or lower from the GY.
Junk Converter
Discards with a Tuner to search a Synchron; as material, revives a Tuner.
Assault Sonic Warrior
Summons itself next to Junk Warrior or its cards; searches a Synchron or Assault Mode Activate.
Full-Speed Warrior
Summoned: searches Junk Synchron or a Junk Warrior Spell/Trap.
Junk Mail
Level 1 Tuner that revives from the GY next to a Warrior, Synchron or Stardust Synchro.
Scrap Synchron
Counts as any Synchron and can be material from the hand.
Assault Synchron
Summons itself from the hand as a Level 2 Tuner.
Doppelwarrior
Generic: joins when a monster is revived; as material, makes two Tokens.
Quillbolt Hedgehog
Generic Level 2 that revives itself next to a Tuner.
Junk Warrior/Assault Mode
Assault Mode Activate's target: unaffected by their monster effects.
Synchro Fellowship
Adds Junk Synchron and a Junk Warrior or Stardust card, then discards.
Junk Signal
Quick-Play: Tributes to summon a Junk Warrior card, or negates a response to your Synchro.
Over Tuning
Generic: summons a Tuner from the hand, Deck or GY.
Duel Evolution - Assault Zone
Field Spell: searches an Assault Mode card and lets Assault Mode Activate Tribute from the Extra Deck.
Assault Mode Activate
Tributes Junk Warrior to summon Junk Warrior/Assault Mode.
Synchro Emergency
Trap you can flip from the hand going second: summons from the hand, then a Synchron from the Deck.
extra: Level 5 for a Synchron: summons a Synchron of every Level from the Deck.
Level 5 for Junk Synchron: the card the whole engine names.
Level 8: revives every Level 2 or lower from the GY.
Level 10 on Synchros: destroys a card per Synchro in the GY.
Level 8: Sets Assault Mode Activate and fetches an Assault Mode monster.
Level 8: destroys a card per non-Tuner material.
Level 6: switches a monster's position on either turn.
Level 5 Synchro Tuner: mills a Synchron to change its Level.
Level 2 Synchro Tuner: draws, and Synchro Summons on their turn.
Level 7: shrinks a monster for each Junk banished.
Link-2 for a Tuner and a Warrior or Machine: Synchro Summons on either turn.
